rationale: CNN (Aug 30) & Scripps News (Aug 27) report Trump plans to use MAGA Inc. funds to rescue embattled GOP nominee Ken Paxton in Texas (where Democrat James Talarico leads polls and outspent GOP 7-to-1 while NRSC/SLF wait for MAGA Inc. to take the lead), alongside JD Vance headlining MAGA Inc. s kickoff event in Michigan.
